notes.title: Join the Playtest to test local co-op!
notes.notes: [p]Hi my fellow worm gamers![/p][p]This weekend we're testing local co-op! Grab a friend, maybe some controllers, and [url="https://discord.com/invite/NJdN26q5YF"]let me know[/url] what works well and what needs changing! The Playtest runs until Monday![/p][p][/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]Rune-dev![/p]

notes.title: Playtest weekend, and soon Early Access release!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi there! We're soon finally approaching release times for Worm Game! We're doing a Playtest every other weekend, plus another next weekend, and aiming for [b]Early Access in November! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]All Steam wishlists are much[b] [/b]needed and appreciated![/p][p][/p][p]The first [b]Playtest is live[/b] right now and will be going throughout this weekend! Got big updates this time, and would love it if any and all fellow readers of this post could test the game and give some feedback on [url="https://discord.gg/hGNTgSAbxn"]Discord[/url]. Just head over to the Steam page[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444930/WORM_GAME/"][/dynamiclink] and click the big Playtest button! (Also check the new video on the Steam page).

[b]New in this playtest[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]A ton of new and revamped levels! The levels are also divided into chapters (beware placeholder names). Story Mode now has 60 (of 66) levels ready, most of which are new.[/p][/*][*][p]Some revamped in-game UI and flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Crosshair cursor (as requested by many).[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of music.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There's a bunch of new stuff coming up soon, and next weekend's Playtest will be focused on local co-op 🎮🎮[/p]

notes.title: Steam Playtest available until Nov 10!
notes.notes:
Hi! Worm Game has a Steam Playtest this weekend from 8-10 November. I'd love for you to try the game in its current state, and please join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/EN7DBbqaQw]discord[/url] and let me know what you think! It has some hitches and bumps and lacking some content and polish, so know that the full release will have more stuff!

- Rune (developer)
